scope: Same outcome-blind scientific design; NEW dependency-scoped execution only, not v1 resume

data.series: BINANCE USD-M BTCUSDT linear USDT perpetual trade OHLCV only

calculation.qualification: reuse unchanged research/preparation/features.cjs sourceArm/eligibility/atrPercentile/calendar; no assessSnapshot score/day/RSI gate
calculation.volumeMemo: pure volumeReference by immutable fixed-origin index; no indicator/parser serialized or rolling state
calculation.selection: all qualified zones; one GLOBAL first valid per zone/side before coordinate tail exclusions; no sigAt/backtest invocation

population.V: mutually exclusive cls2 with qualified reference and positive range
population.C: cls0 with qualified reference and positive range
population.polarity: Local C>=O (doji up); SHORT up-zone H<decision close, LONG down-zone L>decision close
population.midpoint: original (H+L)/2, untouched after source through decision inclusive; equality is a touch
population.calendar: decision-close UTC; Q3 before 2026-10-01T00:00Z, October [2026-10-01,2026-11-01); weekends calendar Sat/Sun; not funding schedule

matching.cutpoints: unweighted post-chronology eligible V type7 Q1/3,Q2/3; unique finite cuts; equality lower bin; unbounded outer bins; constant one bin disclosed
matching.weights: all V=1; all C=nV/nC within retained cell; no alternative matching/thinning
matching.transforms: logAge=ln(ageBars), logAtrClose=ln(ATR_t/close_t), ATR midrank uses preceding288 excluding t

balance.denominator: fixed pre-match sqrt((sampleVarV+sampleVarC)/2), independently per reported population; no post-weighted SD
balance.undefined: equal zero-variance neutral only; missing/insufficient/unequal constant fail explicitly; both arms required
balance.gateFailure: NOT-INTERPRETABLE for this design; no bin/gate change

outputs: same/cross-arm coordinate window overlaps/shared decision times

execution.mode: dependency-scoped causal origin series; only in-memory, no rolling reseed/resume
consumed: fixed-origin ATR current and preceding288 excluding current
final source census through last queried index
execution.unchangedScience: require perp-support-v1/design.cjs directly; do not recode frameRows/takeFirst/match/summarize
execution.parity: EXACT assert.deepStrictEqual for every consumed frame and frameRows result; complete synthetic episodes/IDs/matches/census; same seven retained-data indices; ANY failure terminal before market cohort; no tolerance
execution.causality: classification depends on bar j and previous10; ATR induction from a=0 at origin with unchanged seed/operation order; snapshot i reads only indices<=i
execution.initialization: compute consumed series once in causal index order; at(i) returns copied current/prior/recent slices; no future recovery or outcome data

resources.projectedMs: all31425 decisions × max observed restricted at+frameRows ms ×2 +60000 matching/output reserve; must fit remaining minus2000 cleanup ms
resources.memoryAdmission: 2 × observed combined parent/worker RSS must fit1GiB
resources.scope: input verification + original oracle parity + restricted initialization/benchmark + full preparation + output
